_comment: The score's cues (make_score.py): each one mood for one stretch of the film, generated with Stable Audio 3. A cue's picked take (picks.json "score/<cue>") is slid so its peak lands on "hit", and heard from "from" to "to" (a shot's start plus offset), faded over their "fade" seconds; 0 is a hard stop. "peak" maps a take to its peak in seconds when the ear disagrees with the measured one. gainDb is the whole score's level in the edit. "duck" rides the score under every voice (make_score.duck): at least "margin" dB below the line.

cues._comment: Beat 1: a low, mysterious pulse under the announcements, steady, no hit; it fades out into the first hit at c07.
cues.prompt: Cinematic film score, instrumental, Cold War mystery and expectation: a low ticking pulse of muted staccato strings and a soft synth clock, sustained cellos and basses, a distant low brass note now and then. Quiet and restrained throughout, steady energy, never building, no drums. Modern space-film trailer music, 80 BPM, D minor.

cues._comment: Beat 2: the race is on. Starts on a big hit at c07 ("and what a race it was!"), then a tense driving pulse that keeps building through Sputnik and Vanguard; it stops as the Vanguard burns, leaving the beep alone for Flopnik.
cues.prompt: Cinematic orchestral film score, instrumental. It opens with one huge boom of drums and low brass, then a tense, driving ostinato of staccato strings and ticking percussion, Cold War suspense, slowly building with horns, snare and timpani, more and more urgent. Modern space-film trailer music, 80 BPM, D minor.

cues._comment: Beat 3: rises under the Soviet calendar to the first big swell as Gagarin flies (c17), heroic through Shepard and Glenn, and swells again under Kennedy; it hands over to the drive at the beat's end. Take 1's swell arrives 6 s in (its loudest moment, 14 s, is later in that phrase).
cues.prompt: Cinematic orchestral film score, instrumental, wonder and heroism. A short quiet rise of strings and a snare roll grows quickly into a huge soaring swell of the full orchestra with French horns, brass and cymbals, then carries on broad, proud and heroic with a noble horn theme over driving strings and timpani. Modern space-film trailer music, 80 BPM, D major.

cues._comment: Beat 4: crossfades in under the end of Kennedy's sentence, builds to a hit as the montage of firsts begins (c23a) and drives it; the music stops dead on the memorials (c27a).
cues.prompt: Cinematic orchestral film score, instrumental. It begins quietly with low strings and a heartbeat drum, building steadily for fifteen seconds to a big hit of the full orchestra, then an energetic, optimistic driving montage: pulsing strings, punchy brass, propulsive drums and timpani, confident and forward-moving at full power. Modern space-film trailer music, 80 BPM, D major.

cues._comment: Beat 5: the music comes back after the black, rises under the rollout and the Apollo 8 launch, peaks on the photograph (the shutter click, the one moment without words), and fades out with the picture to black.
cues.prompt: Cinematic orchestral film score, instrumental, emotional and full of wonder. It begins very quietly with a low sustained string note and a soft heartbeat drum, grows steadily with ostinato strings, French horns and a timpani roll into a huge, soaring, triumphant peak of the full orchestra with brass and cymbals about two thirds of the way through, then falls away to shimmering high strings and a soft held chord. Modern space-film trailer music, 80 BPM, D major.

cues._comment: Beat 6: low, ticking suspense from the cut out of the black; it cuts out on the N1's flash.
cues.prompt: Cinematic film score, instrumental, dark nervous suspense at night: a low ticking clock pulse, tremolo strings, a deep sustained bass drone, a quiet heartbeat drum, tension slowly rising. Restrained, no melody, no big hits. Modern space-film trailer music, 80 BPM, D minor.

cues._comment: Beat 7: the long final build from the launch to the boot; at its peak as the boot comes down (c36), cut dead at the black.
cues.prompt: Cinematic orchestral film score, instrumental, one long continuous crescendo full of hope and triumph: from quiet low strings and a heartbeat drum it grows steadily with ostinato strings, French horns, snare roll and timpani, rising higher and higher to an enormous, euphoric peak of the full orchestra with brass, choir-like pads and cymbals. Modern space-film trailer music, 80 BPM, D major.

cues._comment: The end card: one warm, held final chord as the logo builds.
cues.prompt: Cinematic orchestral film score, instrumental: a single warm, glowing final chord of the full orchestra and soft brass in D major, swelling gently and ringing out with shimmering high strings and a soft cymbal, then fading to silence. A trailer logo ending.
